Nipsey Hussle, born Ermias Joseph Asghedom on August 15, 1985, was a legendary Los Angeles rapper, entrepreneur, activist, and community leader from the Crenshaw District of South Central LA. Known for his independent hustle, powerful messages, and dedication to uplifting his community, Nipsey became one of the most respected figures in West Coast hip-hop. He gained widespread recognition through projects like The Marathon, Crenshaw, and his Grammy-nominated debut studio album Victory Lap in 2018. Beyond music, Nipsey was passionate about entrepreneurship, ownership, and creating opportunities for his neighborhood. He co-founded The Marathon Clothing store at Crenshaw and Slauson, turning it into a symbol of inspiration and community pride. Nipsey tragically passed away on March 31, 2019, at just 33 years old, but his impact continues to inspire millions worldwide. His famous message, “The Marathon Continues,” lives on through his family, businesses, music, and community initiatives. 🏁💙🕊️ 

Blacc Sam, whose real name is Samiel Asghedom, is a Los Angeles entrepreneur, businessman, and the older brother of legendary West Coast rapper Nipsey Hussle. Growing up in South Central Los Angeles, Blacc Sam played a major role in helping his younger brother build The Marathon brand from the ground up. As Nipsey’s longtime business partner, he helped establish The Marathon Clothing and turn their vision into a successful business. Following Nipsey’s passing in 2019, Blacc Sam dedicated himself to protecting his brother’s legacy while continuing to expand their business empire. From clothing and community initiatives to Marathon Burger, Blacc Sam has remained committed to keeping Nipsey’s vision alive. Known for staying humble, working behind the scenes, and leading by example, Blacc Sam continues to demonstrate that The Marathon Doesn’t Stop. 🏁💙🍔
